Package global.thalion.ttio.workbench.transport

package global.thalion.ttio.workbench.transport
Workbench-aware WebSocket transport.

Speaks the ttio-transport WS subprotocol against tti-workbench-server v1.0.0+. Distinct from TransportClient which targets the Python reference server (no auth, no container_uri, no project/owner).

Entry points:

  • WorkbenchTransportClient -- end-to-end upload + download against a v1.0 daemon.
  • WorkbenchHandshake -- pure JSON builders / parsers for the wire frames. No I/O; reused by tests + tooling.
  • ResumeState -- resume bookkeeping for partial uploads.

Cross-language equivalent: Python ttio.workbench.transport. The JSON shapes on the wire are byte-identical to the Python builder so the cross-language equivalence test can compare them directly.
